nodes.description: mapping(address => uint256) balances holding token balances of each holder
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) allowed holding ERC20 allowances
constant totalSupply_ fixed at 1000000000000000000, minted entirely to the pool address in the constructor
constructor(address _poolAddr) assigns the whole supply to _poolAddr and emits Transfer
public pure totalSupply() returning the constant totalSupply_
public view balanceOf(address) returning balances[tokenOwner]
public transfer(address,uint) debiting msg.sender and crediting receiver via SafeMath
public approve(address,uint) overwriting allowed[msg.sender][delegate] with numTokens without checking the previous value
public view allowance(address,address) returning allowed[owner][delegate]
public transferFrom(address,address,uint) moving tokens using allowance and balances with SafeMath sub/add
library sub(uint256,uint256) using assert(b <= a) before subtracting
library add(uint256,uint256) using assert(c >= a) before returning
msg.sender is the externally controlled caller used both as the token owner and as the spender in allowance checks
balances[msg.sender].sub(numTokens) arithmetic debit inside transfer guarded by a manual require and SafeMath assert
balances[owner].sub(numTokens) arithmetic debit inside transferFrom
allowed[owner][msg.sender].sub(numTokens) allowance decrement inside transferFrom
direct overwrite of allowed[msg.sender][delegate] enabling the classic approve front-running race
balances[buyer].add(numTokens) arithmetic credit inside transferFrom
receiver address parameter of transfer
numTokens amount parameter of transfer
delegate address parameter of approve, becomes the allowance spender
numTokens amount parameter of approve, becomes the allowance value
owner address parameter of transferFrom whose balance is debited
buyer address parameter of transferFrom whose balance is credited
numTokens amount parameter of transferFrom used for both balances and allowance computation
tokenOwner address parameter of balanceOf
owner address parameter of allowance
delegate address parameter of allowance
_poolAddr address parameter of the constructor receiving the entire total supply

edges.reason: balances mapping value of msg.sender is read and written by the sub operation in transfer
transfer function executes the sub on balances[msg.sender]
msg.sender authorizes and funds the outbound transfer, so authorization depends on caller identity
balances[owner] is read and written by the sub operation in transferFrom
transferFrom executes the sub on balances[owner]
balances[buyer] is read and written by the add operation in transferFrom
transferFrom executes the add on balances[buyer]
allowed[owner][msg.sender] is read and written by the sub operation in transferFrom
transferFrom executes the sub on the allowance of msg.sender
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance is consumed in transferFrom
allowed mapping is unconditionally overwritten by approve
approve performs the unchecked allowance overwrite
msg.sender is the allowance owner set in approve, creating the approve race condition
transfer writes updated balances back into the balances mapping
transferFrom writes updated balances for owner and buyer
transferFrom decrements the stored allowance
approve writes the new allowance into the allowed mapping
constructor initializes balances[_poolAddr] with the whole supply
constructor credits the constant totalSupply_ amount
totalSupply returns the constant totalSupply_
balanceOf reads the balances mapping
transfer reads balances of sender and receiver
allowance reads the allowed mapping
receiver parameter is credited in transfer
numTokens parameter drives the require check and accounting in transfer
numTokens parameter is subtracted from balances[msg.sender]
delegate parameter is the spender key in approve
numTokens parameter is the allowance value in approve
delegate parameter is written as the allowance spender without any guard
numTokens parameter becomes the overwritten allowance amount
owner parameter is the debit source in transferFrom
buyer parameter is the credit destination in transferFrom
numTokens parameter is checked against both balance and allowance in transferFrom
numTokens parameter is subtracted from balances[owner]
numTokens parameter is subtracted from the caller allowance
numTokens parameter is added to balances[buyer]
owner parameter identifies the balance that is debited in transferFrom
buyer parameter identifies the balance that is credited in transferFrom
tokenOwner parameter selects the balance read by balanceOf
owner parameter selects the allowance owner in allowance
delegate parameter selects the allowance spender in allowance
_poolAddr parameter receives the full supply in the constructor
transfer delegates its subtraction to SafeMath.sub, which only uses assert
transferFrom delegates balance and allowance subtraction to SafeMath.sub
transfer delegates the receiver credit to SafeMath.add
transferFrom delegates the buyer credit to SafeMath.add

normalization_plan.reason: receiver is a plain address parameter only consumed by the transfer routine
numTokens is the subtrahend of the arithmetic debit performed in transfer
delegate is only used as the key of the overwritten allowance entry
numTokens is only used as the value written into the allowance entry
owner selects the balance that transferFrom debits
buyer selects the balance that transferFrom credits
numTokens is the amount arithmetically applied to balances and allowance in transferFrom
tokenOwner is a read-only lookup key local to balanceOf
owner is a read-only allowance lookup key local to allowance
delegate is a read-only allowance lookup key local to allowance
_poolAddr is only used once to seed the initial balance in the constructor
